description: One accepted capture owns the camera lifecycle until terminal READY or FAILED/recovery
A second capture cannot execute concurrently with an active capture lifecycle
Elapsed expected duration alone cannot declare the session dead
Candidate count is discovered from camera state/descriptors not inferred from mode
Successful host completion requires terminal candidate reconciliation
User DNG is not blindly deleted to clear capture state
USB identity and PTP/session health are observed independently
Automatic recovery records its initiating reason and phase
Fresh READY is proven by clean state and subsequent operation
OpenPolaris is not required to reproduce a lower-layer pgphoto/libgphoto2 defect
